page.overview:
What is Five Nights at Freddy's: Help Wanted?

, commonly abbreviated to FNaF: HW and also known as Five Nights at Freddy's VR or FNaF VR, is an independent sit-and-survive action horror game developed by Steel Wool Studios, Inc. and published by Scottgames, LLC, which released on May 28, 2019, for SteamVR, PlayStation VR, Oculus Rift, and HTC Vive, as the eighth installment in the Five Nights at Freddy's series. A non-VR mode was released on December 17, 2019, for Windows and PlayStation 4.

Help Wanted later got ported to Nintendo Switch on May 21, 2020, Meta Quest on July 16, 2020, and Xbox One on October 30, 2020. Now-delisted Android and iOS ports were released on October 26, 2020, though they lacked a lot of content from the game and added a hidden minigame, called Princess Quest. PICO VR systems would receive a port in 2023, which was followed by an enhanced edition on November 21, 2023, ported by Pingle Studio, Ltd., under the subtitle Full Time Edition, for the PlayStation 5 and PlayStation VR2.

A sequel, Five Nights at Freddy's: Help Wanted 2, was released on December 14, 2023.

Five Nights at Freddy's: Help Wanted is a collection of classic and original mini-games set in the Five Nights universe. Survive terrifying encounters with your favorite killer animatronics in a collection of new and classic FIVE NIGHTS AT FREDDY'S™ experiences. "Where fantasy and fun come to life!"
